en.headline: M+ to open Herzog & de Meuron exhibition for fifth anniversary
en.dek: The West Kowloon museum said the Focus Gallery show, opening on 12 September, draws on a donation from the Swiss firm that designed the building.
body: M+ said an exhibition titled Herzog & de Meuron: In Focus would open on 12 September in the Focus Gallery on the second floor, marking the museum's fifth anniversary with a donation from the Swiss architecture practice that designed the West Kowloon building.

The museum said the presentation would include newly donated models, drawings and material samples. It focuses on built and unbuilt projects in China, among them M+ itself (2012 to 2021), Tai Kwun in Central (2006 to 2018) and the National Stadium in Beijing (2002 to 2008), as well as urban planning work that considers how territory and landscape shape cities.

Objects will be shown in replicas of the wooden vitrines developed for the firm's Kabinett repository at its Basel foundation. M+ quoted co-founder Jacques Herzog as saying in 2002 that, because architecture itself cannot be exhibited, the practice is compelled to find substitutes. The museum described the open-storage format as a way to look at the thinking behind the work.
The exhibition page lists the opening date and gallery but does not yet state a closing date. Tickets are sold through the museum's usual admission system.

zh.headline: M+五周年展出Herzog & de Meuron捐贈建築藏品
zh.dek: 西九M+博物館宣布，《Herzog & de Meuron：聚焦》將於9月12日在二樓焦點空間開幕，展出來自該館建築事務所的捐贈。
body: M+表示，展覽《Herzog & de Meuron：聚焦》將於9月12日在二樓焦點空間開幕，以瑞士建築事務所Herzog & de Meuron向館方捐贈的藏品，紀念博物館開幕五周年。M+大樓正是由該事務所設計。
館方指展覽將展出新近捐贈的模型、繪圖和物料樣本，聚焦事務所在中國的已建成及未建成項目，包括M+本身（2012至2021年）、中環大館（2006至2018年）和北京國家體育場（2002至2008年），以及回應地域與地景如何塑造城市形態的規劃項目。
展品會置於仿製自事務所巴塞爾基金會Kabinett貯藏室的木造展示櫃。M+引述聯合創辦人Jacques Herzog 2002年的說話，指建築本身無法被展出，他們必須尋找替代品。館方形容這種開放式貯藏展示，讓觀眾近距離了解作品背後的創作過程。
展覽專頁目前只列開幕日期及展廳，未公布結束日期。門票經博物館既有售票系統發售。
